name: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd
title: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd - 524715 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Sun is buying Organon for $3.99bn equity / $11.75bn EV, funded with $2–2.5bn cash plus debt, taking net debt/EBITDA to 2.3x; a capital allocation shift, not a supply-side read.

triggers.label: Organon deal: EV $11.75bn, net debt/EBITDA 2.3x
triggers.quote: we will also see that Sun from a net cash positive position post this acquisition will get into a net debt by EBITDA of 2.3x

triggers.label: Synergies ~$350m over 2–4 years
triggers.quote: could be in the range of about $350 million which could be materialized in the next two to four years

triggers.label: Dividend continuation unclear
triggers.quote: We haven't fully reflected on this. However, our internal cash flow calculations have always considered continuing payment of dividend.
triggers.highlight: We haven't fully reflected on this

guidance.quote: could be in the range of about $350 million which could be materialized in the next two to four years
we will also see that Sun from a net cash positive position post this acquisition will get into a net debt by EBITDA of 2.3x
we believe this will be EPS accretive from the beginning
we expect this deal to close in about six to nine month time

red_flags.label: Debt-funded deal; dividend policy unresolved
red_flags.quote: We haven't fully reflected on this.

red_flags.label: Organon growth flat; no numeric revenue plan
red_flags.quote: the established product business which is stagnant today and not growing

we need to do a much more detailed analysis
